biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (CPS by 22C3)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Pembrolizumab + chemotherapy first-line advanced ESCC in tumors with PD-L1 CPS ≥10; nivolumab-based first-line therapy uses a different PD-L1 assay/definition in major trials and is not defined by 22C3 CPS. Adjuvant nivolumab (CheckMate 577) after neoadjuvant CRT and surgery if residual disease

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.clinical_use: Very common truncal alteration; mainly biologic/prognostic, not standard therapy-selective

biomarkers.name: CCND1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common hallmark driver amplification in ESCC; prognostic/biologic, not standard therapy-selective

biomarkers.name: SOX2 / TP63
biomarkers.prevalence: SOX2 and/or TP63 amplification recurrent (~40-60% regionally at 3q26-28)

biomarkers.name: NFE2L2 / KEAP1 / CUL3 pathway
biomarkers.prevalence: Recurrent oxidative stress pathway alterations (~10-20% collectively)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Recognized recurrent ESCC driver pathway; prognostic/biologic

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma of the esophageal mucosa

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Often inflamed — PD-L1 high in a substantial subset; tobacco/alcohol-associated tumors may show increased mutational burden, but TMB is variable rather than uniformly high
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Desmoplastic; central necrosis and cavitation in large tumours

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Basal cells of esophageal stratified squamous epithelium
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm — foregut derivative (esophagus develops from primitive foregut)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Keratinizing squamous with characteristic intraepithelial neoplasia progression (mild → moderate → severe dysplasia → invasive SCC)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Field cancerization from tobacco/alcohol produces multifocal disease; chronic thermal injury (hot beverages) in high-incidence regions drives similar field effect
